{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dup_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_dup_counts[patient_dup_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicate_count}')

# Show the highest sample_seq for each patient
highest_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Unique patient IDs: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(data)}')

# Confirm the rule: keep highest sample_seq per patient
# Create a deduplicated dataset keeping only the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication
print(f'After deduplication: {len(data_dedup)} rows, {data_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()} unique patients')"}
